scripts.build:all: pnpm db:generate && pnpm --filter @innsight/shared build && pnpm --filter @innsight/database build && pnpm --filter @innsight/api build && pnpm build:web && pnpm db:template && pnpm --filter @innsight/desktop build
scripts.db:template: cross-env DATABASE_URL="file:./template.db" prisma db push --schema=packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma --skip-generate --accept-data-loss 2>nul || echo Database template already exists
scripts.build:web: cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=/api/v1 pnpm --filter @innsight/web build && node scripts/fix-standalone-nm.mjs
